gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-tibetan: Wide and commanding, Goldman draws round forms like open parentheses. Noto Serif Tibetan brings a literary serif whose lowercase rises nearly to cap height, its stroke shifts felt more than seen, and that is the real draw.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-todhri: Goldman is wide, bold, and fond of round, open-parenthesis shapes. It handles big display moments with confidence, while Noto Serif Todhri, a classic serif with sturdy thin points and a sizable x-height, does the quieter reading work.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-toto: Noto Serif Toto reads heavy and dignified, like chalk pressed hard. Over pages of text it would feel weighty yet literary, with subtle stroke modulation, while Goldman shouts wide and bold in the headings.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-vithkuqi: Noto Serif Vithkuqi reads editorial, with big round lowercase bowls. Stems run a touch heavier than the crossbars, so page after page feels settled and classic, with Goldman adding wide, bold headings.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-yezidi: Noto Serif Yezidi reads as solid word blocks, not jagged skylines. Its gently tapered strokes feel alive beside Goldman, whose wide, commanding letters bring the bold edge while the serif brings classic polish.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-odor-mean-chey: Odor Mean Chey reads dignified and editorial, its a, e, and s squeezed to narrow mouths. And Goldman, with its open, wide-set letters, offers a heading that opens up everything the body keeps closed.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-pt-serif-caption: PT Serif Caption has a clearly tall x-height you notice instantly. Goldman is best at wide, bold display work, while the serif is best at restful lines with modest swings in stroke weight.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-suez-one: Suez One reads bookish and refined, with tall-bowled, open-looking e and a. Goldman's open, wide-set letters against that serif's narrow counter channels make the pair's real strength: two voices, one loud, one studied.
gen-gf-goldman-lora: Goldman stands out for its big lowercase, tall against the capitals and set wide. And Lora, a text serif with modest hairline thinning and a welcoming c, reads literary and bookish from page to page.
gen-gf-goldman-merriweather: Merriweather reads cozy and refined, its very tall middle band making each line look stocky. And Goldman does the bold, wide display work, while the serif's gentle modulation keeps paragraphs comfortable.
